description: Returns the signed-in player's record as their profile shows it, over their latest 200 finished battles except practice games, optionally narrowed. record: battles, won, lost, drawn, rate (win rate 0 to 1, a draw counting half), going first and second, average points, streaks, command points, stratagems and secondary cards used, primary missions, opposing factions and opponents. performance: the same split per detachment, primary mission and battle size. facets: the values each filter takes, with battle counts. rankings: leaderboard places from rated public battles, overall and per faction, unaffected by the filters. List the battles themselves with list_my_battles. Requires mcp:read.

detachment.description: A detachment name you fielded, exactly as facets.detachments lists it.

faction.description: A faction slug you fielded, from facets.factions or list_factions.

limit.description: A battle size in points, such as 2000.

missionPackId.description: A mission pack id from facets.missionPacks.

opponentDetachment.description: A detachment name an opponent fielded, from facets.opponentDetachments.

opponentFaction.description: A faction slug an opponent fielded, from facets.opponentFactions.

opponentId.description: An opponent player id from facets.opponents.

name: get_my_stats
title: Read my battle statistics
